summary: Mereo BioPharma filed an 8-K under Item 2.02 to disclose Q1 2026 financial results and a corporate update. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The excerpt discusses setrusumab data analysis with partner Ultragenyx and regulatory engagement plans, but these are ordinary business updates. Hence, this is a routine earnings report with no event-driven category.
